resources.string: Force stop SampleApp and reopen it to apply these settings on the next cold start.
Delay the first home screen frame by 3 seconds
Open a test screen in a separate process

To test a return from the background, press Home while the splash screen is visible. Wait a few seconds, then reopen SampleApp without clearing it from Recents.\n\nFor a normal cold start, turn both options off.

Separate process test

Press Home, wait 5 seconds, then tap the SampleApp icon. Leave SampleApp in Recents.

This test screen closes when it goes into the background. You will return to the home screen in SampleApp.
